scientific_integrity: Combinatorial proof and independent direct-definition finite enumerations. Literature overlap checks distinguish strict from full continuous monoids. No independent validation or absolute novelty certification claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only full continuous partial-function monoids of K_{m,n} with m,n>=2; no complete Green relations or complexity. The motivating 2026 preprint was checked at abstract level, so historical-priority uncertainty remains. Exhaustive computation is confined to graphs of at most six vertices; the general claim has a combinatorial proof.
title: Rank, regularity, and idempotents in complete-bipartite graph-continuous monoids
